conditions.title: Scapula anterior tilt
conditions.summary: Anterior tipping of the scapula can reduce comfortable overhead mechanics and contribute to shoulder compensation.

conditions.title: Round shoulder
conditions.tags: Upper crossed syndrome, shoulder impingement, rib flare
conditions.tightMuscles: Pectoralis minor, pectoralis major, latissimus dorsi
conditions.summary: A forward shoulder position commonly combines restricted anterior tissue with reduced scapular control.

muscles.title: Serratus anterior
muscles.function: Scapular protraction, upward rotation, and control against the rib cage
muscles.insertion: Anterior medial border of the scapula
muscles.notes: Often trained when improving overhead reach and scapular control.

muscles.title: Lower trapezius
muscles.function: Scapular depression, upward rotation, and posterior tilt support
muscles.insertion: Medial end of the scapular spine
muscles.notes: Useful in programming for shoulder positioning and overhead mechanics.

muscles.title: Pectoralis minor
muscles.function: Scapular anterior tilt, downward rotation, and protraction
muscles.notes: Assess before using inhibition or mobility work; avoid treating posture from one muscle alone.

recipes.title: Squat preparation
recipes.goal: Improve comfortable squat depth and reassess symptoms
recipes.equipment: Vibrating massage ball, open floor space
recipes.steps:
1. Release the hamstrings with a vibrating massage ball.
2. Perform a controlled splitting stretch.
3. Execute a full squat and reassess pain and movement quality.
recipes.cautions: Stop if pain increases or symptoms radiate. This is education, not diagnosis.

recipes.title: Scapular control sequence
recipes.goal: Restore comfortable scapular movement before loaded overhead work
recipes.steps:
1. Address rib flare and breathing position.
2. Use gentle pectoralis minor mobility if indicated.
3. Practice serratus anterior control.
4. Reassess overhead reach.
recipes.cautions: Use a pain-free range and avoid forcing the shoulder into end range.
